rows.name: EERAGH ISLAND
rows.description: Tower, 101 ft. high, white, with red belts, on West point

rows.name: Straw Island
rows.description: Shown betw. W. by N. ½ N. & S.E. Vis. from inside Arran Isles. Buildings white

rows.name: Inisheer
rows.description: Tower, 112 ft. high, with broad red belt, on S. pt. Lt. is red in direction of Finnis Rock

rows.name: Mutton Island
rows.description: On centre of island, off Galway

rows.name: LOOP HEAD
rows.description: White tower, 75 ft. high, 500 yds. from extr. of head. Lt. bright 20 secs., eclipsed 4 secs. Shown from N.E. by E. ½ E. to S.E. by E.

rows.name: Kilcradan
rows.description: On the point. Red to seaward; bright to river

rows.name: Scattery Island
rows.character: One fix. br. or red lt.
rows.description: Tower on S. end of island, River Shannon. Lt. is red over Rinana Shoal, between N.N.E. and N.E. by E. ½ E. Bright light eclipsed landward between N.E. ¾ E. and N.W. by W. ½ W.

rows.name: Beeves Rocks
rows.description: Red to N. of rock. Eleven small lights below Limerick

rows.name: Tralee
rows.description: On Little Samphire Island. Br. lt. seaward, from N. ½ W. to W. by N. ½ N., and red over anchorage from W. by N. ½ N. to E. by S. [?] S.

rows.name: TEARAGHT ISLAND
rows.description: Lighthouse, 57 ft. high. Lt. shown between S. ¾ E. to E. by N. ¾ N.

rows.name: Valentia
rows.description: White tower, 48 ft. high, on Cromwell's Fort

rows.name: SKELLIGS
rows.description: On highest rock, 7½ miles from shore. Lt. shown from lower tower, only visible to the southward between N.W. ½ N. and E. by S. ½ S. Upper tower not lighted

rows.name: CALF ROCK
rows.description: Tower red, with white belt, 102 ft. high

rows.name: Bantry Bay
rows.description: White tower, 62 ft., with red belt, at East entrance to Bearhaven. Light shown from E. ¾ S. to N.W. by W. ¾ W.

rows.name: Crookhaven
rows.description: On Rock Island Point. Tower, 112 ft. high, with broad red belt, on S. point. Lt. red across rocks to Streek Head, from S. [?] W. to S.E.byE. Bright to southward

rows.name: FASTNET ROCK
rows.description: Circular white tower, 92 ft. high, with red belt, on the summit of the rock
